finalText:
**Redis died at 02:14:07 and took prod down 17 minutes later.**

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14–02:31 | 13 reconnect tries, all refused |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` heap out of memory |
| 02:31:52 | `api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

Cache loss forced direct store reads. Store overloaded, queue depth climbed 52 to 568, past the 500 max.

Log has 188 errors and 2 FATAL in [logs/app.log](logs/app.log:719). Every timeout is a symptom, not a cause.

Next: check why Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections.
